notes: Pearl has no premine. All supply is issued to miners through the block subsidy.
Future emissions are projected at the recent block pace and are estimates only.

Mining Rewards.methodology: PRL block subsidy paid to miners, calculated from daily block heights using the consensus subsidy formula. Transaction fees are excluded since they are not new supply.

mining-rewards.name: Block Subsidy
mining-rewards.methodology: Daily block counts from prlscan.com, applied to minted(H) = 2.1B * H / (H + 650,226). Days before the prlscan window are found by searching block timestamps on pearlchain.live.

Mining Rewards (forecast).methodology: Projected block subsidy over the next 4 years at the trailing 30-day average block pace
